thread.title: Chief James Taunton concludes term as Garden City Fire Department chief

author: d. w. maldonado
title: Chief James Taunton concludes term as Garden City Fire Department chief
text:
Chief James Taunton attended his final Board meeting on April 6, following a two-year term as the head of the Garden City Fire Department. Taunton joined the department in 2012 and advanced through various leadership roles, including Third Assistant Chief, before serving two terms as Chief of Department.
Taunton holds national certifications as a Firefighter I and Incident Safety Officer. He moved to Garden City in 2000 and currently works at NYU Langone Hospital—Long Island as a Registered Nurse and Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist. In this role, he focuses on staff and patient education regarding diabetes management, along with policy development within the hospital.
During the meeting, Mayor Ed Finneran thanked Taunton for his service. “Thank you for an extraordinary two years. I shared both of them with you, as did most of this Board,” Finneran said. “You’ve done a terrific job. Your dedication, you’re full time on the job, recently married juggling a lot of different things. Both Vinny Muldoon and I were at the unfortunate fire on Stewart and Washington. It was a three-alarm fire. There were chiefs and assistant chiefs all around Chief Taunton as decisions had to be made on a momentary basis. It was very impressive to see.”
Trustee Vincent Muldoon, who serves as Fire Commissioner, also acknowledged Taunton’s contributions by saying: “Thank you. You’re a Class act. It was a pleasure working with you.”
Taunton received a standing ovation from those present at the meeting. In response he said: “Thank you to the Board of Trustees, especially the Mayor and the Fire Commissioner. We’ve had a very productive year. We got Station 2 done, we got a fire truck approved and hopefully this training center goes through. It’s been an absolute pleasure,” he said during his remarks to attendees at Village Hall.
“To all the Department Heads, it’s been a truly great experience to work with everyone and really understand how this Village works,” Taunton added in closing comments about his tenure leading local firefighters.
